taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO. Multiple varieties are recognized in regional treatments; the learner remains species-level and does not assign a variety from flower color alone.

evidence: Travis County — UT Plant Resources Center and COLO herbarium records document Callirhoe involucrata.
Tom Green County — COLO herbarium has a non-cultivated Texas specimen explicitly from Tom Green County.
Williamson County — UT Plant Resources Center provides field-based treatments for C. involucrata var. involucrata and var. lineariloba.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Cultivated winecups are common. The user's current iNaturalist records are cultivated and are not used for native-county proof.

morphology.look_here_first: Check growth habit and the structures immediately below the calyx. Winecup is a perennial with low trailing/decumbent stems and an involucel of 3 bractlets beneath the flower. The calyx lobes are already divergent in bud rather than meeting to form a pointed bud.
diagnostic_traits: stems decumbent/trailing to weakly erect, generally much lower than tall poppymallow
leaves alternate, roundish in outline and deeply 3–5(–7)-lobed
foliage hairy with stellate and simple hairs
three involucellar/epicalyx bractlets immediately below calyx
calyx lobes divergent in bud, not forming an apiculate point
flowers cup-shaped; petal color variable and secondary for ID
schizocarp with 10–28 indehiscent mericarps; beaks not strongly prominent

confusers.separator: C. leiocarpa is annual/biennial and tall/erect, lacks involucellar bractlets, has calyx lobes meeting into a pointed bud, and has glabrous dehiscent mericarps with prominent beaks.
C. pedata is an erect/ascending perennial and lacks the low trailing winecup habit; fruit and leaf architecture should be checked when flowers are absent.
Texas poppy-mallow is stiffly erect, densely stellate-hairy and taller; winecup is low/trailing and has different hair/habit characters.

diagnostic_roles: flower bud side showing divergent calyx tips
photo_verification.user_photo_note: Current tracker observations are cultivated, so useful for morphology only—not range.
